description:
Launch the 'Practice the addition operation' activity in GCompris (located in the Math/Calculation category). Complete Level 1 by correctly answering at least 5 consecutive addition problems. The problems will be simple single-digit additions. After completing the level, create a text report at '/home/ga/Documents/addition_report.txt'. The report must include:
1. A header 'GCompris Addition Practice Report'
2. The number of problems solved
3. At least 3 examples of the problems you solved and their answers (format: '3 + 5 = 8')
4. A note about the difficulty level.
